headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would temporarily lead the EPA if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which Environmental Protection Agency officials would act as the agency's head, in order, if the Administrator and Deputy Administrator die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so details about the specific positions listed are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a ranked line to temporarily serve as acting head of the agency if top leaders are unavailable.
